textos.Várias reviews descrevem as interpretaçõ: Several reviews describe the performances as theatrical and uncomfortable, with the lead in her debut judged exaggerated and unnatural, even sounding childlike in scenes of fragility.
textos.Remake desnecessário e inferior ao origi: Unnecessary remake, inferior to the original
textos.O filme é tratado como uma refilmagem su: The film is treated as a superfluous remake of an earlier work by the same director, worse in almost every respect, including the replacement of the original cautionary structure with a clichéd police investigation.
textos.O tom melodramático é levado ao extremo,: The melodramatic tone is taken to the extreme, resulting in constant emotional swings and a mood bordering on the hysterical, without the film seeming clear about what it wants to be.
textos.A segunda metade perde o interesse visua: The second half loses the visual interest of the first, with generic lighting and repetition of sets, while the script scatters into subplots that do not connect to the main story.
textos.Apesar das críticas, algumas reviews rec: Despite the criticism, some reviews acknowledge that the cinematography and editing still impress, gaining texture through the use of colors absent from the original version.
textos.Confusão temática e falta de conexão: Thematic confusion and lack of connection
textos.Espectadores relatam não entender a prop: Viewers report not understanding the film's approach, with opening comments that do not fit the main narrative and an experience that does not generate emotional engagement.
textos.Comparação com o original e natureza de: Comparison with the original and remake nature
textos.Este grupo de reviews medianas aponta qu: This group of middling reviews points out that the film is essentially a remake by the same director, with a very similar narrative structure, and that the comparison with the original work is inevitable and, for many, unfavorable.
textos.As reviews medianas destacam que as atua: Middling reviews highlight that the performances are often exaggerated, melodramatic and unnatural, which, for some, compromises the film's overall impact.
textos.Este grupo elogia a fotografia colorida,: This group praises the colorful cinematography, with intense, contrasting colors that create a striking visual aesthetic, although it is not enough to overcome other perceived flaws.
textos.Excesso de melodrama e tom de novela: Excess of melodrama and soap-opera tone
textos.As reviews medianas criticam o tom exces: Middling reviews criticize the excessively melodramatic tone, comparing it to that of a soap opera, which makes the experience tiring and not very engaging for a portion of the audience.
textos.Algumas reviews medianas mencionam probl: Some middling reviews mention pacing problems, with slow moments and a sense of predictability that reduces the narrative's impact.
textos.Mistura de estilos e referências (giallo: Mix of styles and references (giallo, psychedelia, trash)
textos.Este grupo observa uma fusão de influênc: This group observes a fusion of influences ranging from giallo to psychedelic and trash cinema, resulting in a peculiar work that divides opinion but never goes unnoticed.
textos.Muitas reviews positivas comparam este f: Many positive reviews compare this film with the original 1960 version, noting that, although it is a remake of the same story by the same director, this version brings vibrant colors, more chaos and a bolder approach, although some prefer the tension of the black-and-white original.
textos.A atuação de Youn Yuh-jung em sua estrei: Youn Yuh-jung's performance in her debut is widely praised for its unrestrained energy and screen presence, described as hypnotizing and frightening, contributing to the film's intensity.
textos.O uso de cores saturadas, iluminação exp: The use of saturated colors, expressionist lighting and bold framing is highlighted as one of the strengths, creating a psychedelic, stylized atmosphere reminiscent of giallo and exploitation cinema.
textos.O filme é descrito como histérico, absur: The film is described as hysterical, absurd and delirious, with extreme twists and a spiral of madness that, although it may seem excessive, holds interest through its boldness.
textos.As reviews apontam que a trama aborda di: Reviews point out that the plot addresses power dynamics, female exploitation and social hypocrisy, touching on themes such as patriarchy and bodily autonomy in a disturbing and still relevant way.
textos.A presença de cenas violentas e sexualme: The presence of violent and sexually suggestive scenes, often skirting the censorship of the time, is mentioned as part of the exploitation appeal, with montages of still images and a more graphic approach.
textos.Lançado em 1971 e dirigido por Kim Ki-yo: Released in 1971 and directed by Kim Ki-young, Woman of Fire is a feature film that combines crime, drama and horror over its 100-minute running time. The plot follows the daily life of a composer and his wife, who live on a chicken farm and see their routine collapse with the arrival of a femme fatale at the residence.
textos.A experiência cinematográfica se estrutu: The cinematic experience is structured on a dense melodramatic atmosphere, driven by expressive framing and lighting with strong visual appeal. The staging adopts an ostentatious tone and a pacing dynamic marked by theatrical drama and the contrasting use of color.
textos.Na maioria das notas (~66%), grande part: In most of the ratings (~66%), a large portion of the comments compare the production with the original work, stressing how the new version adds visual boldness and energy to the material. In this favorable segment, a significant share praise Youn Yuh-jung's debut performance for its intensity on screen, while several highlight the stylized cinematography and saturated colors as high points of the aesthetic construction.
textos.Numa parcela das notas (~29%), a recepçã: In a share of the ratings (~29%), the reception is divided: for those in this middle range, about half consider that the remake nature brings inevitable parallels that weaken the film against the earlier classic. In addition, a good portion complain about the excessively theatrical nature of the performances, although a considerable number point to the vibrant, stylized use of color as an element of merit.
textos.Por fim, numa fração mínima das notas (~: Finally, in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~5%), the verdict is strictly critical: in this reading, the cast's performances are held to be histrionic and uncomfortable, the feature is labeled a superfluous, inferior remake, and the excessive melodrama is blamed for an out-of-control tone.
